note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, proved: The l1 norm and the pair norm ||a+bs|| = ||a||_1 + 2||b||_1 are defined, their submultiplicativity is proved, and normDiv_size gives deg f_n <= (n+1)^3 and ||f_n|| <= 2^(100(n+1)^3); the recurrence slack is handled inside divF_size.
